title: PrivacyGenomic: equitable_rwe -- Real-World Evidence, Health Equity & Causal Outcomes Analytics Platform
description: A reproducible pipeline turning OMOP-CDM-formatted EHR data into causally valid, fairness-audited clinical outcome estimates and health-equity intelligence. Includes equitable_rwe (doubly-robust IPTW-adjusted Cox regression with integrated subgroup fairness auditing), a from-scratch Fine-Gray competing-risks implementation, a four-estimator causal-adjustment benchmark against a known ground truth, an AEQUITAS-equivalent fairness audit, and an open-source health-equity dashboard. Uses only synthetic and public-aggregate data; no real patient data is used anywhere.
